The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 5a9d714fd656a2c9), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 20. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Suppose D satisfies Theorem 2.2 and k0 > √ 0.98, γ < √︂ 49/45. Fix t ∈ (0, 1]. Assume the two-electron ground level is isolated and simple with an even ionic singlet, and the three-electron ground level in Sz = 1/2 is isolated and simple, is an absolute ground level, and has a real axisymmetric odd ground state. Assume nt > 0, and set k = √︂ 2(E2(t) − E3(t)), At(r) = e−kr r(2−2t)/k−1 . Suppose 2ϵb − E3(t) > 0.49, 0.99 < k < γ, inf ωz>0 lim inf r→∞ ∥PtFtrue,t(rω)∥ ωzAt(r) > 0. (3.48) Then nt has the local regularity in Theorem 2.4, is smooth away from the nuclei, and satisfies Equations (3.5) to (3.7) at this fixed coupling, with A = At and suitable positive constants. Membership of t in the preceding perturbative interval is not required.
